questions.explanation: The annual number of live births per 1,000 people is called the Crude Birth rateہر ایک ہزار افراد کی سالانہ پیدائش کی شرح کو خام پیدائش کی شرح کہا جاتا ہے۔the annual number of deaths per 1,000 people is called the Crude death rateہر ایک ہزار افراد کی سالانہ اموات کو خام اموات کی شرح کہا جاتا ہے۔

questions.prompt: If the mean of 7 terms is 40, the sum of those terms will be?
questions.explanation: The mean is calculated by dividing the sum of the terms by the number of terms. Mean=Sum of the terms/Number of terms​Given that the mean is 40 and there are 7 terms, we can find the sum as:40=The sum of the terms/7​Multiplying both sides by 7: Sum of the terms=40×7=280
